11	## 🚀 Features
12	
13	### Core Capabilities
14	- **Multi-Model Switching** - Seamlessly switch between LLMs using standard names (e.g., `gpt-4o`, `claude-3.5-sonnet`)
15	- **MCP Protocol Support** - Connect to any MCP server (stdio, streamable-http, sse)
16	- **Three Agent Modes** - Quick (L1), Expert (L3), Task (L4-L5 with MoA)
17	- **Container Isolation** - Secure agent execution in Docker containers (NanoClaw-inspired)
18	- **Edge-Cloud Collaboration** - Three-tier data security (S1/S2/S3) (EdgeClaw-inspired)
19	- **GUI Agent Support** - Computer use and desktop automation (UI-TARS-inspired)
20	
21	### Model Management
22	- **Standard Model Names** - Canonical names for 8+ popular LLMs
23	- **Alias Support** - Multiple names for the same model (e.g., `gpt4o` = `gpt-4o`)
24	- **JSON Import** - Batch import models with full configuration
25	- **Keyword Search** - Find models by provider, capability, or keywords
26	- **Model Groups** - Pre-defined groups (Reasoning, Coding, Fast, Vision, Chinese)
27	- **Usage History** - Track recently used models

43	
44	```bash
45	# Clone the repository
46	git clone https://github.com/oxygen-claw/oxygen-claw.git
47	cd oxygen-claw
48	
49	# Install dependencies
50	npm install
51	
52	# Build packages

56	## 🎯 Quick Start
57	
58	### CLI Usage
59	
60	```bash
61	# Initialize a new project
62	oxygen-claw init --template advanced
63	
64	# Switch to a model
65	oxygen-claw models --switch gpt-4o
66	
67	# Run a task
68	oxygen-claw run "Research AI trends 2025" --mode expert
69	
70	# Run with specific model
71	oxygen-claw run "Write code" --switch-model claude-3.5-sonnet
72	
73	# Manage MCP servers
74	oxygen-claw mcp --add '{"id":"fs","transport":"stdio","command":"npx","args":["-y","@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem","/path"]}'
75	
76	# Start gateway
77	oxygen-claw gateway --start
78	```
79	
80	### Model Switching
81	
82	```bash
83	# Switch by standard name
84	oxygen-claw models --switch gpt-4o
85	
86	# Switch by alias
87	oxygen-claw models --switch gpt4o
88	oxygen-claw models --switch claude-3-5-sonnet
89	
90	# Find model by keywords
91	oxygen-claw models --match "vision coding"
92	
93	# Show current model
94	oxygen-claw models --current
95	
96	# Show usage history
97	oxygen-claw models --history
98	```

171	## 🔄 Multi-Model Switching
172	
173	OxygenClaw 的核心创新之一是多模型无缝切换：
174	
175	### Standard Model Names
176	
177	每个模型都有唯一的**标准名称**，用于精确切换：
178	
179	```typescript
180	// 标准名称示例
181	const standardNames = [
182	  'gpt-4o',           // OpenAI
183	  'claude-3.5-sonnet', // Anthropic
184	  'gemini-2.5-pro',    // Google
185	  'step-3.5-flash',    // StepFun
186	  'deepseek-v3',       // DeepSeek
187	  'qwen-2.5-72b',      // Alibaba
188	  'llama-3.1-405b',    // Meta
189	  'mistral-large'      // Mistral
190	];
191	```
192	
193	### Aliases
194	
195	每个标准名称可以有多个别名：
196	
197	```typescript
198	// 示例：gpt-4o 的别名
199	const aliases = ['gpt4o', 'gpt-4', 'gpt4', 'openai-gpt-4o'];
200	
201	// 都可以切换到同一个模型
202	registry.switchModel({ modelName: 'gpt-4o' });
203	registry.switchModel({ modelName: 'gpt4o' });
204	registry.switchModel({ modelName: 'gpt-4' });
205	```
206	
207	### Model Registry
208	
209	```typescript
210	import { createModelRegistry, suggestModelNames, normalizeModelName } from '@oxygen-claw/core';
211	
212	const registry = createModelRegistry();
213	
214	// 注册模型
215	registry.registerModel({
216	  id: 'my-model',
217	  name: 'gpt-4o',           // 标准名称
218	  displayName: 'GPT-4o',
219	  provider: 'OpenAI',
220	  // ... other config
221	  aliases: ['gpt4o', 'gpt-4']  // 别名
222	});
223	
224	// 切换模型
225	registry.switchModel({ modelName: 'gpt-4o' });
226	
227	// 获取建议
228	const suggestions = suggestModelNames('gpt');
229	// ['gpt-4o', 'gpt-4-turbo', 'gpt-4', 'gpt-3.5-turbo']
230	
231	// 标准化名称
232	normalizeModelName('gpt4o');  // 'gpt-4o'
233	normalizeModelName('gpt-4');  // 'gpt-4o'
234	```

236	## 🧠 ODC Dynamic Cognition
237	
238	Five cognitive levels with confidence-gated early exit:
239	
240	| Level | Name | Use Case | Web Searches |
241	|-------|------|----------|--------------|
242	| L1 | Fast Response | Simple queries | 1 |
243	| L2 | Step-by-Step | Structured tasks | 2-3 |
244	| L3 | Reflective | Complex analysis | 10 |
245	| L4 | Multi-Path | Parallel exploration | 5 |
246	| L5 | Collaborative | MoA multi-agent | 5 |
247	
248	## 💾 OMM Hierarchical Memory
249	
250	- **TLB Hot-Page Cache** - 70%+ hit rate for fast access
251	- **Pointer-Linked Associations** - Natural knowledge graph formation
252	- **Cross-Page Merging** - Combine related memories
253	- **Version Control** - Track memory changes
254

282	## 🎨 Material 3 WebUI
283	
284	- **Dynamic Color Theming** - Automatic light/dark mode
285	- **Responsive Design** - Works on desktop, tablet, mobile
286	- **Dashboard** - Real-time stats and monitoring
287	- **Model Management** - Visual model switching interface
288	- **Task Tracking** - Monitor agent execution
289	- **MCP Management** - Server and tool visualization
290	
291	## 🐳 Container Isolation
292	
293	Inspired by NanoClaw, each agent runs in an isolated Docker container:
294	
295	```typescript
296	const container = await containerManager.createAgentContainer({
297	  image: 'oxygen-claw/agent:latest',
298	  resourceLimits: {
299	    cpu: '1',
300	    memory: '2g',
301	    pids: 100
302	  },
303	  networkMode: 'bridge'
304	});
305	```
306	
307	## 🌐 Edge-Cloud Collaboration
308	
309	Inspired by EdgeClaw, three-tier data security:
310	
311	- **S1 (Public)** - Can be processed in cloud
312	- **S2 (Sensitive)** - Requires anonymization
313	- **S3 (Private)** - Must stay local
314	
315	## 📊 Cost Optimization
316	
317	Smart routing selects the most cost-effective model:

328	```

2	
3	You are rewriting the OxygenClaw WebUI. Treat the current frontend as a visual/reference prototype, not as the architectural source of truth.
4	
5	## Product Positioning
6	
7	OxygenClaw is a broad Claw-style agent platform. The frontend should feel like a polished agent workbench for:
8	
9	- Persistent chat conversations
10	- Long-running task execution
11	- ComputerUse / GUI automation execution
12	- Runtime event inspection and replay
13	- Model/provider management
14	- MCP agent/task management
15	- Marketplace/CLI skill management
16	- Settings and system status
17	
18	The backend is being rebuilt around persistent runtime tasks and event streams. New frontend architecture should use these backend contracts directly instead of recreating local-only state.
19	
20	## Important Direction Change
21	
22	Do not overfit to the current `PlaygroundsV2.tsx` implementation.
23	
24	The old UI had good visual ideas but weak data flow:
25	
26	- Too much `localStorage` state
27	- Chat/task/computeruse paths mixed together
28	- Runtime events were not first-class
29	- Direct browser LLM calls existed as fallback behavior
30	- Task state was not recoverable after refresh
31	
32	The new UI should make backend state the source of truth.
33	
34	## Recommended Architecture
35	
36	Use a frontend architecture with explicit domains:
37	
38	- `api/` for backend clients
39	- `features/conversations/`
40	- `features/runtime/`
41	- `features/models/`
42	- `features/mcp/`
43	- `features/settings/`
44	- `features/marketplace/`
45	- `components/` for shared UI primitives
46	
47	Suggested runtime state model:
48	
49	- Conversations are chat timeline containers.
50	- Runtime tasks are execution records.
51	- Runtime events are the live/replayable execution stream.
52	- Worker runs are backend execution lifecycle records.
53	
54	Avoid storing canonical conversations or task state only in browser storage. Local storage can be used for view preferences, draft input, theme, sidebar state, and last selected IDs.
55	
56	## Backend Base URL
57	
58	Development:
59	
60	```text
61	http://localhost:3001/api
62	```
63	
64	If using Vite proxy, frontend may call `/api`.
65	
66	Auth token, if present:
67	
68	```http
69	Authorization: Bearer <token>
70	```
71	
72	Most JSON responses follow:
73	
74	```json
75	{
76	  "success": true,
77	  "data": {}
78	}
79	```
80	
81	Errors:
82	
83	```json
84	{
85	  "success": false,
86	  "error": "message"
87	}
88	```
89	
90	## Version
91	
92	Current product display version:
93	
94	```text
95	v26.0 Alpha 1
96	```
97	
98	Package semver:
99	
100	```text
101	26.0.0-alpha.1
102	```
103	
104	Health endpoint:
105	
106	```http
107	GET /api/health
108	```
109	
110	Returns:
111	
112	```json
113	{
114	  "success": true,
115	  "data": {
116	    "status": "ok",
117	    "timestamp": "2026-07-04T00:00:00.000Z",
118	    "version": "26.0.0-alpha.1",
119	    "displayVersion": "v26.0 Alpha 1"
120	  }
121	}
122	```
123	
124	## Models
125	
126	### List enabled models
127	
128	```http
129	GET /api/llm/models
130	```
131	
132	Use `data.models[].id` as the canonical model ID for chat/task requests.
133	
134	Example model ID:
135	
136	```text
137	providerId:modelName
138	```
139	
140	## Conversations
141	
142	Conversations should be the source of truth for visible chat/task timelines.
143	
144	### List conversations
145	
146	```http
147	GET /api/conversations?mode=chat
148	```
149	
150	Modes:
151	
152	- `chat`
153	- `task`
154	- `computeruse`
155	
156	### Create conversation
157	
158	```http
159	POST /api/conversations
160	```
161	
162	Request:
163	
164	```json
165	{
166	  "title": "New conversation",
167	  "modelId": "providerId:modelName",
168	  "mode": "chat",
169	  "capability": "fast"
170	}
171	```
172	
173	### Get conversation detail
174	
175	```http
176	GET /api/conversations/:id
177	```
178	
179	Returns `conversation` and ordered `messages`.
180	
181	### Chat message generation
182	
183	```http
184	POST /api/conversations/:id/messages
185	```
186	
187	Request:
188	
189	```json
190	{
191	  "content": "hello",
192	  "modelId": "providerId:modelName"
193	}
194	```
195	
196	SSE format is OpenAI-compatible:
197	
198	```text
199	data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello"}}]}
200	
201	data: [DONE]
202	```
203	
204	After `[DONE]`, reload `GET /api/conversations/:id` to sync real backend message IDs.
205	
206	### Save message without generation
207	
208	Use this for task/computeruse results.
209	
210	```http
211	POST /api/conversations/:id/messages
212	```
213	
214	Request:
215	
216	```json
217	{
218	  "role": "assistant",
219	  "content": "result text",
220	  "generate": false
221	}
222	```
223	
224	### Other conversation routes
225	
226	- `PUT /api/conversations/:id`
227	- `DELETE /api/conversations/:id`
228	- `POST /api/conversations/:id/regenerate` SSE
229	- `POST /api/conversations/:id/messages/:messageId/edit` SSE
230	- `POST /api/conversations/:id/messages/:messageId/feedback`
231	- `GET /api/conversations/suggestions/prompts?mode=chat`
232	
233	## Runtime Tasks
234	
235	Runtime tasks are the source of truth for long-running execution state.
236	
237	### Runtime task shape
238	
239	```json
240	{
241	  "id": "uuid",
242	  "userId": null,
243	  "conversationId": null,
244	  "kind": "agent",
245	  "prompt": "task prompt",
246	  "task": "task prompt",
247	  "mode": "task",
248	  "capability": "fast",
249	  "modelId": "providerId:modelName",
250	  "status": "running",
251	  "result": "optional result",
252	  "error": "optional error",
253	  "createdAt": 1783140000000,
254	  "startedAt": 1783140000000,
255	  "updatedAt": 1783140000000,
256	  "completedAt": null,
257	  "cancelledAt": null,
258	  "metadata": {},
259	  "events": [],
260	  "workerRuns": [],
261	  "steps": []
262	}
263	```
264	
265	Statuses:
266	
267	- `pending`
268	- `running`
269	- `completed`
270	- `failed`
271	- `cancelled`
272	
273	`pending` means the runtime worker manager has accepted the task into its queue but has not started it yet.
274	
275	Kinds:
276	
277	- `agent`
278	- `computeruse`
279	
280	## Agent Task Execution
281	
282	```http
283	POST /api/agent/execute
284	```
285	
286	Request:
287	
288	```json
289	{
290	  "prompt": "do something",
291	  "mode": "task",
292	  "capability": "fast",
293	  "modelId": "providerId:modelName"
294	}
295	```
296	
297	SSE examples:
298	
299	```text
300	data: {"type":"task_start","taskId":"uuid","status":"running"}
301	
302	data: {"type":"step","step":{"type":"think","content":"...","timestamp":1783140000000}}
303	
304	data: {"type":"task_complete","taskId":"uuid","status":"completed","result":"...","steps":[]}
305	```
306	
307	Important: even failures are persisted as runtime events.
308	
309	### Preferred long-running task start
310	
311	```http
312	POST /api/agent/start
313	```
314	
315	Request body is the same as `/api/agent/execute`, but the response is JSON immediately:
316	
317	```json
318	{
319	  "success": true,
320	  "data": {
321	    "taskId": "uuid",
322	    "workerRunId": "uuid",
323	    "status": "pending",
324	    "eventsUrl": "/api/agent/tasks/uuid/events/live"
325	  }
326	}
327	```
328	
329	## ComputerUse Execution
330	
331	```http
332	POST /api/agent/computeruse/execute
333	```
334	
335	Request:
336	
337	```json
338	{
339	  "task": "open app and inspect screen",
340	  "modelId": "providerId:modelName"
341	}
342	```
343	
344	The SSE format is the same as task execution. GUI-related steps may contain `step.action`.
345	
346	Preferred long-running start endpoint:
347

350	```

352	## Runtime Query And Replay
353	
354	### List runtime tasks
355	
356	```http
357	GET /api/agent/tasks
358	```
359	
360	### Get one runtime task
361	
362	```http
363	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id
364	```
365	
366	Returns task with:
367	
368	- `events`
369	- `workerRuns`
370	- derived `steps`
371	
372	### Get events
373	
374	```http
375	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id/events
376	```
377	
378	Incremental fetch:
379	
380	```http
381	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id/events?afterSeq=3
382	```
383	
384	### Replay events as SSE
385	
386	```http
387	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id/events/stream?afterSeq=3
388	```

396	```

399	
400	```http
401	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id/events/live?afterSeq=3
402	```

407	
408	```http
409	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id/workers
410	```
411	
412	Use this for technical task diagnostics.
413

415	
416	```http
417	GET /api/agent/runtime/workers
418	```
419	
420	Use this for runtime diagnostics and dashboard health. It returns max concurrency, queued count, running count, registered worker adapters, queued task IDs, and running task heartbeats.

423	
424	```http

426	```
427

433	
434	```http

436	```
437

439	
440	```http

442	```

444	## Recommended UI Flows
445	
446	### Chat flow
447	
448	1. Ensure model selected.
449	2. Create or load conversation.
450	3. Send `/api/conversations/:id/messages`.
451	4. Render OpenAI-compatible chunks.
452	5. On `[DONE]`, reload conversation detail.
453	
454	### Task flow
455	
456	1. Create or load a `mode=task` conversation.
457	2. Save user message with `generate:false`.
458	3. Prefer `POST /api/agent/start`.
459	4. Store `taskId` from the JSON response.
460	5. Subscribe to `/api/agent/tasks/:taskId/events/live?afterSeq=<lastSeq>`.
461	6. Render live SSE events.
462	7. Track last seen `seq` where available.
463	8. If disconnected, recover with `/api/agent/tasks/:taskId/events?afterSeq=<lastSeq>` or `/events/live`.
464	9. Save final assistant/result message with `generate:false`.
465	
466	### ComputerUse flow
467	
468	Same as task flow but use `/api/agent/computeruse/execute` and render `step.action` when present.
469	
470	## Suggested Screens
471	
472	- Dashboard: health, recent tasks, model status, failures
473	- Playgrounds/Workbench: conversation list + message timeline + runtime event panel
474	- Task Detail: event timeline, steps, worker runs, raw JSON toggle
475	- Models: provider/model management
476	- MCP: registered agents and tasks
477	- Marketplace: skills and CLI status
478	- Settings: theme, defaults, multimodal, privacy/runtime settings
479	
480	## Do Not Do These
481	
482	- Do not store canonical conversations only in `localStorage`.
483	- Do not treat SSE as non-recoverable; use runtime event replay.
484	- Do not bypass backend for normal model calls.
485	- Do not couple task UI directly to old `agent_tasks` rows.
486	- Do not assume task failure means no useful data; failed tasks still have events.
487	- Do not design ComputerUse UI as plain chat only; it needs actions, screenshots/artifacts later, and worker diagnostics.
488	
489	## Current Backend Limits To Design Around
490	
491	- Runtime persistence exists and local execution now goes through an in-process worker manager with queueing, concurrency limits, heartbeat, and stale-task sweep.
492	- Workers are not separate OS processes or containers yet.

495	- Container workers are not implemented yet.
496	- True PTY terminal sessions are not implemented yet.
497	- ComputerUse operator/runtime needs another backend phase.
498	- Attachments/artifacts are not fully first-class yet.
499	
500	Design the new frontend so these can be added without rewriting the UI again.

36	      type: s.type,
37	      content: s.content,
38	      timestamp: s.timestamp

40	
41	    for (const step of steps) {
42	      if (context.isCancelled()) return;

62	    const message = error.message || 'Unknown error';

两个文件都读全了,第 3 批的拼图完整了。取消链路的真相比预想的好:

**取消基础设施其实是通的:**
- `cancel(taskId)`(worker manager:87-107)会置 `active.cancelled=true`,并调 `adapter.cancel?.(taskId)`
- adapter 的 cancel 指向 `cancelAgent`(activeAgents:6),它从 map 取出 agent 调 `agent.cancel()`
- core 的 `agent.cancel()` 置 `cancelled=true`,而 `runCognitionLoop` 的 while 检查它(agent.ts:324)

**那为什么取消实际无效?** 病灶精确定位到:`generateOutput` 里的 `await callLLM(...)`(agent.ts:535)是最耗时的一步(等 LLM 响应),而 while 循环的取消检查在**两次迭代之间**,没有穿透到这个 await 内部。所以取消一个正在等 LLM 的任务,得等这次 LLM 调用返回后、下一次循环判断时才生效。对于 L3/L4 长任务(多次循环)取消基本可用,但单次长 LLM 调用无法中断。

For `runInsert`, I'll capture the `lastInsertRowid` from the result info object. 但布尔/undefined 绑定陷阱还得查——better-sqlite3 遇到 JS 布尔或 undefined 参数会直接抛错。扫一遍所有 `runExec`/`runInsert` 调用点确认。
扫完了。绑定陷阱的排查结果很关键:

**布尔值风险点找到一个:** `llm.ts:1047` — `UPDATE models SET enabled = ?`,`newEnabled` 可能是 JS 布尔。还有几处 INSERT models 表时 `supports_vision` 等布尔字段。better-sqlite3 遇到布尔会直接抛 `TypeError: SQLite3 can only bind numbers...`。

我在重写 db.ts 时会**在 `runQuery`/`runExec`/`runInsert` 内部做一层参数归一化**:把 `boolean → 0/1`、`undefined → null`。这样既保持签名不变,又能吸收所有调用点的布尔/undefined,不用去改十几个路由文件。这是最稳的兼容策略。

但从代码看，`sweepStaleTasks` 已经调用了 `recordRuntimeEvent`，而 `recordRuntimeEvent` 会 emit 到 event bus，SSE 客户端通过 `subscribeRuntimeEvents` 在监听...

```typescript
router.get('/tasks/:id/events/live', optionalAuth, (req: AuthRequest, res) => {
  // ...
  const replayedEvents = listRuntimeEventsAfter(taskId, afterSeq);
  for (const event of replayedEvents) {
    res.write(...)}

  const latestTerminalEvent = [...replayedEvents, ...listRuntimeEvents(taskId)]
    .reverse()
    .find(event => event.type === 'task_complete' || event.type === 'task_error' || event.type === 'task_cancelled');

  if (latestTerminalEvent) {
    res.write('data: [DONE]\n\n');
    res.end();return;
  }

  const unsubscribe = subscribeRuntimeEvents(taskId, event => {
    res.write(...)
    if (event.type === 'task_complete' || event.type === 'task_error' || event.type === 'task_cancelled') {
      res.write('data: [DONE]\n\n');
      res.end();
      unsubscribe();
    }
  });

  res.on('close', () => unsubscribe());

```

这里有一个 **race condition**：
1. 客户端连接时，历史事件中没有 terminal event
2. 客户端订阅 eventBus
3. 在连接和订阅之间，`sweepStaleTasks` 触发了 `recordRuntimeEvent` 并 emit 到 bus
4. 但客户端在步骤 3 之后才订阅，所以错过了这个事件
5. 客户端永远挂在那里等待

更根本的问题：这里有一个 **check-then-subscribe** 竞态：先检查历史，再订阅，中间如果有新事件就会丢失。

**解决方案**：应该先订阅，再检查历史，或者在订阅后再次检查任务状态。

另一种更实际的问题：当 `sweepStaleTasks` 在服务器内部发出 `task_error` 事件时，如果当时没有任何 SSE 客户端在线（即没有连接），那么事件会被 emit 但没有监听者，事件丢失。当客户端随后连接时，它会在历史事件中找到 `task_error`，并立即关闭。

所以实际上现有代码已经处理了这种情况（历史事件检查）。

让我重新审视，看看真正的 P1-1 issue在哪里：

其实 `streamRuntimeTask`（在 `/execute` 路由里用的，行 144-171）和 `/tasks/:id/events/live` 路由是不同的两个函数：

`streamRuntimeTask`：
- 先回放所有历史事件（`listRuntimeEvents`）
- 然后订阅
- **没有**检查是否已经有 terminal event！

所以如果一个 sweepStaleTasks 在回放和订阅之间触发，客户端就会卡住。

但其实这个不太可能发生，因为如果 terminal event 已经在历史里，它会被回放，并且...

哦等等，`streamRuntimeTask` 回放历史事件后**没有**自动结束连接，它继续订阅等待新事件。即使历史里有 `task_error`，它也不会自动结束 SSE 连接！

这是真实的 bug。`streamRuntimeTask` 应该检查已回放的历史事件里是否有 terminal event。

对比 `/tasks/:id/events/live` 的做法：它会检查历史里是否有 terminal event，有则立即 `res.end()`。

同样，`sweepStaleTasks` 和 `failInterruptedTasks` 在服务器重启/心跳超时后标记任务为 failed，这些终态事件已经在 DB 里，客户端通过 `/live` 端点能正确处理（历史检查后立即关闭），但 `streamRuntimeTask` 不能。

**P1-1 修复**：在 `streamRuntimeTask` 里，回放历史后检查是否已经有 terminal event，有则立即关闭不再订阅。

## P1-2：chat `generate:true` 应该走worker

看 `conversations.ts` 的 `POST/:id/messages`（行 287-434）：
- `generate = true` 时，直接在请求处理函数里调用 `callLLM()`，走 streaming
- 问题：长时间的 LLM 调用占用 Express 请求处理线程（在 Node.js 中实际上是异步的，所以不是"占用线程"，但会有长连接）
- 真正的问题是：这个 chat 请求不通过 RuntimeWorkerManager，所以没有 heartbeat、没有取消机制、没有 task 追踪

但是等等，`chat` 模式和 `agent/task` 模式的差异：
- chat 模式是单次 LLM 调用，流式输出，响应时间取决于 LLM，通常是几秒到几十秒
- 通过 worker 路由意味着会有 task ID、可取消等

原始SPEC 说"chat 走 worker"，意思是应该通过 RuntimeWorkerManager 来管理，支持取消、追踪等。

但实现起来比较复杂：需要一个 `chat-worker` adapter，并且需要改变前端对 chat 的调用方式（轮询 SSE 或者直接 SSE 连接到 `/tasks/:id/events/live`）。

现有代码已经支持 streaming chat，主要缺点是：
1. 无取消机制（没有 AbortController）
2. 无 task 追踪
3. 长时间运行时如果进程崩溃，前端不知道

**简化实现**：至少给conversations.ts 里的 `callLLM` 加上 AbortController 支持，让客户端断开连接时能取消请求。

更完整的实现是通过 RuntimeWorkerManager，但这会大幅改变 API 契约，前端需要同步修改。

鉴于 BACKEND_CONVERSATIONS_SPEC.md 应该是契约，我需要先看它。但文件较大，让我先评估。

从代码看，当前conversations API 是同步 SSE（直接在路由里 stream）。改为 worker 模式会把接口改成：
1. POST messages →返回 202+ taskId
2. 客户端 GET /tasks/:taskId/events/live 来接收流

这是重大 API 变更。前端需要配合改动。

鉴于泽川说"稳定后端后再重写前端"，这个P1-2 的实现策略：
- **保留现有接口**，但在内部改用 RuntimeWorkerManager
- 或者**先加AbortController**（较小改动）

让我看看实际上"chat 走 worker"的最小可行修复是什么：最小方式是给 `callLLM` 加上 `AbortSignal`，当 `res` 的 `close` 事件触发时 abort。这样不改接口，但能正确取消 in-flight 请求。

这比完整的 worker 化更实际，也更安全（不改API 契约）。

## 3. 已完成工作（Lot 1–3）

### Lot 1 · P0-1 · DB 迁移（✅ 已完成）
- **病灶**：旧 `services/db.ts` 用 sql.js，每次写都全库 `export()` + 全量覆盖落盘；`PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL` 对纯内存 WASM 完全无效（虚假安全感）。数据丢失 + 性能灾难。
- **修复**：换成 better-sqlite3。新增 `runTransaction<T>(fn: () => T): T`（包装 `db.transaction(fn)()`）。
- **兼容层**：better-sqlite3 参数绑定比 sql.js 严格，JS 布尔和 `undefined` 会直接抛错。解法：在 `runQuery`/`runExec`/`runInsert` 单一入口做 `normalizeParams`（boolean→0/1、undefined→null、Date→毫秒），上层路由零改动。**此层经冒烟测试确认必需。**
- **备份**：迁移前已备份 `data/oxygenclaw.db.bak-<时间戳>`。

### Lot 2 · P0-2 · event seq 竞态根治（✅ 已完成）
- **病灶**：`services/runtime.ts` 的 `recordRuntimeEvent` 原来用 `SELECT MAX(seq)+1` 与 INSERT 两条独立语句，并发事件可读到同一 MAX 而 seq 冲突，破坏排序与 `afterSeq` 增量拉取。
- **修复**：用 `runTransaction` 在同步事务内串行化「分配 seq + INSERT」（见 `runtime.ts:110-122`）。
- **硬兜底**：`runtime_events` 上的 `(task_id, seq)` **UNIQUE INDEX**（`ensureUniqueRuntimeEventSeqIndex`）。
  - ⚠️ **踩坑**：`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS` 若已存在**同名非唯一索引**（旧 schema 建的），会因名字已存在被静默跳过，唯一约束不生效。迁移做成幂等：先 `PRAGMA index_list` 检测 unique 标志 → 去重现有数据 → `DROP` 旧索引 → 重建为 UNIQUE。

## 4. 关键运行时架构（供理解 Lot 4）

- **RuntimeWorkerManager**（`services/runtimeWorkerManager.ts`）：queue + 并发上限 + 心跳 + `sweepStaleTasks` + `failInterruptedTasks`。
  - `cancel(taskId)` 同时处理排队中和运行中的 job，运行中会调 `adapter.cancel?.(taskId)`。
  - `sweepStaleTasks()` 把心跳超时的 running 任务标 failed，并 `recordRuntimeEvent({type:'task_error'})` —— 这**会**发到事件总线。
- **事件总线**：`runtimeEventBus`（EventEmitter），按 `task:${taskId}` 频道；终态事件类型：`task_complete` / `task_error` / `task_cancelled`。
- **SSE**（`routes/agent.ts`）：`streamRuntimeTask` 与 `/tasks/:id/events/live` 先回放历史事件，再 `subscribeRuntimeEvents` 订阅；收到终态事件写 `[DONE]` + `res.end()`。
- **Settings 加密**：敏感字段（visionApiKey / asrApiKey / ttsApiKey / imageGenApiKey / dashboardApiKey）AES-256-GCM，前缀 `encrypted:aes256-gcm:`。

## 6. 约定与踩坑教训（务必遵守）

### 协作
- 泽川是决策与测试者，小氧实施。**改动前先给方案等拍板**（小而明确的改动除外）。
- 每批改动完**必须编译验证**（`npx tsc --noEmit`）+ 必要时运行时冒烟测试，不留半成品。
- 破坏性/不可逆操作（删多文件、drop 数据库、改生产、force push）先确认。不直接推 main/master。只在明确要求时创建 git commit。

### 数据库
- **DB 改动前先备份**（已有 `data/oxygenclaw.db.bak-<时间戳>`）。
- **tsc 通过 ≠ 运行时正确**。DB 这类地基必须跑运行时冒烟测试。
- better-sqlite3 参数绑定严格（boolean/undefined 会抛）——统一走 db.ts 的 `normalizeParams`。

### 临时 Node 测试脚本
- 要 `require('better-sqlite3')` 的临时脚本**必须放在 `packages/server` 目录内**再跑，放 `/tmp` 会 MODULE_NOT_FOUND（node_modules 解析路径）。
- Bash/终端工具的**工作目录在命令间持久**。若之前已 `cd` 进子目录，再写 `cd packages/server && ...` 会因已在其中而失败、`&&` 链整体断掉。**先确认当前 cwd。**

## P1-2 方案：chat `generate:true` 走 worker manager

### 病灶
`routes/conversations.ts` 四处（`POST /:id/messages`、`/edit`、`/regenerate`、`/generate-title`）直接 `callLLM`，绕过 RuntimeWorkerManager → 无统一并发控制/心跳/取消/事件流/stale 清扫。

### 架构选择（需你拍板）
**选项 A：新增 `local-chat` worker adapter**
- 专门处理 chat 生成，payload 含 `messages` / `modelConfig` / `temperature` 等。
- 优点：chat 与 agent/computeruse 隔离，各自演化；chat 可单独加并发上限。
- 缺点：多一个 adapter 类型。

**选项 B：复用 `local-agent` adapter，mode 分支**
- payload 里加 `kind: 'chat'` 分支，走不同的执行逻辑（不起 OxygenAgent，直接 callLLM）。
- 优点：统一入口，代码量小。
- 缺点：`local-agent` 语义变模糊；chat 与 agent 共享并发池。

**我倾向选项 A**（新增 `local-chat`），因为 chat 是对话场景、agent 是任务场景，本质不同，分开清晰。你怎么看？

### 实施步骤（选项 A）
1. 新建 `packages/server/src/runtime/adapters/localChat.ts`：
   - `run(context)` 拿 payload.messages / modelConfig，调 `callLLM` 流式返回。
   - 把 token 流包装成 `recordRuntimeEvent(type: 'chat_chunk', payload: { delta })` 发到事件总线。
   - 支持 `context.isCancelled()` 检查，传 `signal: abortSignal` 给 callLLM。
2. `runtimeWorkerManager.ts` 注册 `localChatAdapter`。
3. `routes/conversations.ts` 四处改为：
   - 创建 runtime_task（`kind: 'chat'`），enqueue 给 worker manager。
   - 返回 202 + taskId，客户端改为轮询 `/api/agent/tasks/:id/events/live` 拿 SSE 流（或现场改路由支持 chat 的 SSE）。
4. **前端契约不变**：SSE 格式保持 `data: {...}\n\n` + `[DONE]`，`chat_chunk` 事件的 payload 结构对齐现有的 `{ delta, ... }`。

### 风险
- 前端现在期望 `POST /:id/messages` 直接返回 SSE 流，改成"先 202 返回 taskId、再连 `/tasks/:id/events/live`"需前端配合改造。**若要保持现有契约**，可以在 conversations.ts 的路由里仍返回 SSE，但内部改为 enqueue + subscribe 事件总线（类似 agent.ts 的 `streamRuntimeTask`）。

352	## Runtime Query And Replay
353	
354	### List runtime tasks
355	
356	```http
357	GET /api/agent/tasks
358	```
359	
360	### Get one runtime task
361	
362	```http
363	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id
364	```
365	
366	Returns task with:
367	
368	- `events`
369	- `workerRuns`
370	- derived `steps`
371	
372	### Get events
373	
374	```http
375	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id/events
376	```
377	
378	Incremental fetch:
379	
380	```http
381	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id/events?afterSeq=3
382	```
383	
384	### Replay events as SSE
385	
386	```http
387	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id/events/stream?afterSeq=3
388	```
389	
390	Example:
391	
392	```text
393	data: {"type":"step","seq":4,"step":{"type":"output","content":"..."}}
394	
395	data: [DONE]
396	```
397	
398	### Subscribe to live events
399	
400	```http
401	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id/events/live?afterSeq=3
402	```
403	
404	This replays events after `afterSeq`, then stays connected until a terminal event arrives.
405	
406	### Worker runs
407	
408	```http
409	GET /api/agent/tasks/:id/workers
410	```
411	
412	Use this for technical task diagnostics.
413	
414	### Worker manager state
415	
416	```http
417	GET /api/agent/runtime/workers
418	```
419	
420	Use this for runtime diagnostics and dashboard health. It returns max concurrency, queued count, running count, registered worker adapters, queued task IDs, and running task heartbeats.
421	
422	### Worker capabilities
423	
424	```http
425	GET /api/agent/runtime/workers/capabilities
426	```
427	
428	Use this to decide which execution backends are selectable. The default frontend choice should remain `local-agent` unless another worker reports `available: true`.
429	
430	`POST /api/agent/start` accepts optional `workerType`. Current values are `local-agent` and `container-agent`. `container-agent` is registered as a safe scaffold and may report unavailable until Docker and sandbox image wiring are complete.
431	
432	### Cancel task
433	
434	```http
435	POST /api/agent/tasks/:id/cancel
436	```
437	
438	### Delete task
439	
440	```http
441	DELETE /api/agent/tasks/:id
442	```

444	## Recommended UI Flows
445	
446	### Chat flow
447	
448	1. Ensure model selected.
449	2. Create or load conversation.
450	3. Send `/api/conversations/:id/messages`.
451	4. Render OpenAI-compatible chunks.
452	5. On `[DONE]`, reload conversation detail.
453	
454	### Task flow
455	
456	1. Create or load a `mode=task` conversation.
457	2. Save user message with `generate:false`.
458	3. Prefer `POST /api/agent/start`.
459	4. Store `taskId` from the JSON response.
460	5. Subscribe to `/api/agent/tasks/:taskId/events/live?afterSeq=<lastSeq>`.
461	6. Render live SSE events.
462	7. Track last seen `seq` where available.
463	8. If disconnected, recover with `/api/agent/tasks/:taskId/events?afterSeq=<lastSeq>` or `/events/live`.
464	9. Save final assistant/result message with `generate:false`.
465	
466	### ComputerUse flow
467	
468	Same as task flow but use `/api/agent/computeruse/execute` and render `step.action` when present.
469	
470	## Suggested Screens
471	
472	- Dashboard: health, recent tasks, model status, failures
473	- Playgrounds/Workbench: conversation list + message timeline + runtime event panel
474	- Task Detail: event timeline, steps, worker runs, raw JSON toggle
475	- Models: provider/model management
476	- MCP: registered agents and tasks
477	- Marketplace: skills and CLI status
478	- Settings: theme, defaults, multimodal, privacy/runtime settings
479	
480	## Do Not Do These
481	
482	- Do not store canonical conversations only in `localStorage`.
483	- Do not treat SSE as non-recoverable; use runtime event replay.
484	- Do not bypass backend for normal model calls.
485	- Do not couple task UI directly to old `agent_tasks` rows.
486	- Do not assume task failure means no useful data; failed tasks still have events.
487	- Do not design ComputerUse UI as plain chat only; it needs actions, screenshots/artifacts later, and worker diagnostics.
488	
489	## Current Backend Limits To Design Around
490	
491	- Runtime persistence exists and local execution now goes through an in-process worker manager with queueing, concurrency limits, heartbeat, and stale-task sweep.
492	- Workers are not separate OS processes or containers yet.
493	- `container-agent` exists as a non-default backend option for capability probing, but should not be presented as a normal user option unless it reports `available: true`.
494	- On server restart, orphan `pending`/`running` tasks are marked failed rather than left stuck forever.
495	- Container workers are not implemented yet.
496	- True PTY terminal sessions are not implemented yet.
497	- ComputerUse operator/runtime needs another backend phase.
498	- Attachments/artifacts are not fully first-class yet.
499	
500	Design the new frontend so these can be added without rewriting the UI again.

## 技术亮点

### 1. 类型安全

- **ContentBlock 多模态支持** — Message.content 支持 `string | ContentBlock[]`（text/image）
- **时间戳兼容** — `message.timestamp || message.createdAt`（兼容新旧 schema）
- **跨环境兼容** — `ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>` 代替 `NodeJS.Timeout`（浏览器环境）

### 2. SSE 可靠性

- **afterSeq 增量恢复** — 断线时从最后一个 seq 继续，避免重复事件
- **指数退避重连** — `delay = min(1000 * 2^n, 30000)`，最多 5 次
- **`[DONE]` 信号** — 明确流终止，自动清理资源
- **终端事件处理** — task_complete/task_error/task_cancelled 自动 invalidate

### 3. React Query 最佳实践

- **Query keys factory** — 统一管理、类型安全、易于 invalidate
- **乐观更新** — mutations 后自动 invalidate 相关 queries
- **staleTime 分层** — 30s（默认）/ 60s（模型）/ 即时（任务详情）
- **enabled 控制** — 依赖参数存在才触发请求（`enabled: !!taskId`）

### 4. 用户体验

- **加载状态** — LoadingSpinner/LoadingOverlay 统一样式
- **错误处理** — ErrorBoundary + 友好错误页
- **实时反馈** — SSE 状态指示器（绿/黄/红）
- **空状态** — 欢迎页、无任务提示、无事件提示
- **自动滚动** — MessageList 新消息自动滚动到底部

resolution is a critical challenge in software engineering and has garnered increasing attention in recent years. With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), substantial progress has been made in addressing real-world software engineering tasks. Recent studies have introduced ensemble reasoning techniques to enhance the performance of LLM-based issue resolution. However, existing prompting-based methods still face limitations in effectively exploring large ensemble spaces and lack the capacity for repository-level understanding, both of which constrain their overall effectiveness. In this paper, we propose Trae Agent, the first agent-based ensemble reasoning approach for repository-level issue resolution. Trae Agent formulates our goal as an optimal solution search problem and addresses two key challenges, i.e., large ensemble spaces and repository-level understanding, through modular agents for generation, pruning, and selection. We conduct extensive experiments using three leading LLMs on the widely-adopted SWE-bench benchmark, comparing Trae Agent against four state-of-the-art ensemble reasoning techniques. Experimental results demonstrate that Trae Agent consistently achieves superior performance, with an average improvement of 10.22% over all baselines in terms of Pass@1. Trae Agent has achieved first place on the SWE-bench Verified leaderboard, with a notable Pass@1 score of 75.20%. ...
## 概览
...
**Team Mode** 是 AionUi 的多 Agent 协作框架，支持：

- 多个 Agent 同时活跃（leader + teammates）
- Agent 之间通过 mailbox 和 task board 进行异步通信

- **Teammate Agents**：执行者，通过 mailbox 接收任务，via MCP 工具与 leader 协调

## [Feature]: Support Anthropic Computer Use — OS-Level Mouse/Keyboard Automation Tool for Vision-Capable Agents
...
Anthropic shipped Computer Use in October 2024 alongside Claude 3.5 Sonnet — a tool family (`computer`, `bash`, `text_editor`) where the model takes screenshots, emits mouse/keyboard actions, observes the result, and loops until task complete. Cherry Studio's situation today is split: the underlying SDK (`@anthropic-ai/sdk@0.81`, `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.145`) **both ship Computer Use beta types natively**; the Anthropic provider's beta header builder (`src/main/ai/runtime/aiSdk/params/features/anthropicHeaders.ts:28-37`) already conditionally adds beta flags (`interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14`, `web-search-2025-03-05`); the model capability metadata in `packages/provider-registry/data/models.json` **already declares `computer-use`** on Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 4, 4.5, and Haiku 4.5. The agent runtime's tool-execution loop (`Agent.ts:134`, `loop/internal.ts:37-84`) is tool-agnostic and can host the new tool with minimal change. What's missing is the actual wiring: no `computer-use-2024-10-22` in the beta header set, no `computer` tool definition or handler, no OS automation library (no `robotjs`, no `@nut-tree-fork/nut-js`), no screenshot-after-action harness, no consumption of the `computer-use` capability flag to gate availability. Cherry Claw's prompt explicitly tells the agent "you do not have screenshot tools" today. Closing the gap turns Cherry's Agent from a code-only operator into something that can actually drive the user's desktop the same way Anthropic's reference implementation and Claude.ai's Computer Use demo do.
...
Cherry Studio's Agent, when running on a Claude model that supports Computer Use, can autonomously take screenshots, click, type, scroll, and key-press on the user's desktop — looping until task completion — with explicit per-action user approval by default, full permission-mode integration (per #15643), and clear in-chat visibility of every action the Agent takes.
...
- Cherry registers the **`computer` tool** (Anthropic Computer Use 2024-10-22 spec) when the active model's `computer-use` capability flag is true. The tool exposes the standard sub-actions: `screenshot`, `mouse_move`, `left_click`, `right_click`, `middle_click`, `double_click`, `left_click_drag`, `type`, `key`, `cursor_position`, `scroll`.
...
- The Anthropic provider's beta header builder is extended to include `computer-use-2024-10-22` when the active model supports it. Beta flags accumulate (multi-beta header), not replace.
...
- OS automation is provided by `@nut-tree-fork/nut-js` (cross-platform Node-native, MIT, maintained fork of nut-tree). The library is loaded only when the `computer` tool is enabled on an agent, to keep startup overhead off other code paths.
...
- **Per-action approval is the default**: every `computer` tool call surfaces an inline approval in the chat with the action description (e.g. `Click at (450, 320) in the active window?`). The user clicks `Approve` / `Deny` / `Approve all in this session`. This is gated by #15643's permission modes:
...
- `default`: approve per call
 - `acceptEdits`: still approve per call (mouse/keyboard isn't "an edit", it's a real-world action)
 - `bypassPermissions`: silent allow (use with caution; OS-level actions)
 - `plan`: tool not invocable (read-only constraint)
 - `dontAsk`: deny silently
 - `auto`: model-classifier per call — Cherry's classifier wraps the Anthropic model's risk assessment and prompts for high-risk actions (e.g. clicking inside browser address bar, typing into a terminal, dragging to delete)
...
- Sandbox option (per #15643): if the agent has `sandbox: enabled` and uses `computer`, Computer Use is silently disabled and the agent is told "computer tool unavailable in sandbox" — preventing the agent from breaking out of the sandbox via desktop actions.

Title: RNW vs. Electron vs. Native WinUI: A Comparative Analysis for Desktop App Development | ADV88

Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
When you set out to build a desktop application for Windows, one of the most critical decisions you'll make is choosing the right development framework. This choice directly impacts your team's productivity, the application's performance, and the end-user experience. Today, developers are often caught between the allure of web technologies and the power of native platforms. In this article, we will conduct an objective, side-by-side comparison of three prominent contenders: React Native for Windows (often abbreviated as rnw), the ubiquitous Electron, and Microsoft's own native WinUI. Each represents a distinct philosophy in desktop development, from leveraging existing web skills to embracing the full depth of the Windows platform. Understanding their strengths and trade-offs is the first step toward making an informed decision that aligns with your project's goals, team expertise, and performance requirements.
...
Performance is often the most tangible differentiator for end-users. In this arena, the frameworks diverge significantly. Native WinUI stands at the pinnacle of efficiency. Built directly on top of the Windows App SDK, it compiles to native machine code and utilizes the operating system's UI rendering engine directly. This results in lightning-fast startup times, minimal memory footprint, and buttery-smooth animations that perfectly match the system's feel. It's the gold standard for resource-conscious applications.
...
On the other end of the spectrum, Electron packages a full Chromium browser engine (Node.js and the Blink rendering engine) with every application. This provides incredible consistency and power but comes at a cost. A simple "Hello World" Electron app can easily consume hundreds of megabytes of RAM, as each app runs its own isolated instance of Chromium. While this is less of an issue on modern machines with ample memory, it can be a significant drawback for users on lower-end hardware or when multiple Electron apps are run simultaneously.
...
This is where RNW carves out a compelling middle ground. Unlike Electron, RNW does not embed a web browser. Instead, it uses a "bridge" to translate React component trees into native WinUI controls at runtime. Your JavaScript business logic runs in a separate thread, but the UI is rendered using genuine, high-performance native views. This architecture allows RNW applications to achieve much better startup performance and a significantly lower memory footprint compared to Electron, while still offering a development model centered on React. It's a balanced compromise that brings web-like developer agility much closer to native performance levels.
...

The "best" framework doesn't exist in a vacuum; it depends entirely on the project and team. Native WinUI is the undisputed choice for performance-critical, Windows-exclusive software. Think of system utilities, professional creative tools like high-end video editors, or enterprise applications where every millisecond of latency and every megabyte of RAM counts. It's also the path for developers or organizations fully committed to the Microsoft ecosystem and wanting to deliver the ultimate Windows experience.
...
RNW finds its sweet spot with teams that possess strong React skills and are targeting a true multi-platform presence. If you are already building a mobile app with React Native, using RNW allows you to share a substantial portion of your business logic and component design across mobile and Windows desktop. It's an excellent choice for consumer-facing applications, enterprise line-of-business apps, and projects that need a better balance of development efficiency and native performance than Electron provides, but where a full commitment to C#/WinUI is not feasible. The story of RNW is one of strategic compromise, enabling high-quality Windows apps from a shared codebase.

Native WinUI delivers unmatched performance and integration for Windows purists. React Native for Windows (RNW) emerges as a sophisticated and compelling middle path. It successfully bridges the gap, offering the productive, component-based paradigm of React with significantly better performance and native integration than Electron. For teams invested in the React ecosystem and facing a multi-platform reality, RNW presents a robust, modern, and highly viable option for building desktop applications that users will enjoy and that feel right at home on Windows.

 How that clip was made — one play call

A [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server that gives a Claude agent
**full control of the local Windows desktop** — native screen capture, low-level input
injection, video recording, and a play-test loop for driving games and apps.
...
Unlike Anthropic's sandboxed computer-use tool, this runs **on the machine it controls**: it
reads the actual current displays (no resolution requests), is **multi-monitor and per-monitor
DPI aware**, and injects input via `SendInput` **scan codes** so it works in games that ignore
synthetic virtual-key events. Built for full Claude control — no security gating.
...
Anthropic's official [computer use in the Claude Code CLI](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/computer-use)
is a **macOS-only research preview** — Pro/Max only, interactive sessions only (not available with
the `-p` flag). The cross-platform alternative is the Claude Desktop app. There is **no official,
non-Desktop computer-use for Windows**: nothing you can drive headlessly from `claude -p`, from the
API, or wire into an agent over MCP.
...
This server fills that gap. It's a standard MCP server, so it works on Windows in Claude Code
(interactive **and** `-p`), in Claude Desktop, or from any MCP client / custom agent — with no plan
gating — and it's tuned for what a Windows agent actually needs that the sandboxed cloud tool can't
do: real multi-monitor capture, per-window GPU capture, game-grade input, and play-testing.
...
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
...
| **`screenshot`** | See the screen: whole desktop, a `display:N`, a window (even occluded/DirectX via PrintWindow), or a region. Downscaled inline image + a coordinate frame for clicks. |
...
| **`act`** | Do input, batched: `left_click`, `type`, `key`, `scroll`, `drag`, `hold_key`, `paste`, `click_element` (UIA, no pixels), `mouse_move_relative` (game look), … Coordinates are in the last screenshot's image space; the server maps them to physical pixels. |
...
| **`play`** | Drive a **timed input script** at a cadence while recording (scan codes + relative mouse). `probe`/`until` read telemetry per sample and stop early — the closed loop for play-testing. |
...
| **`window`** | Find / focus / close / **read** (`get_text` via UI Automation + OCR) / `click_element` controls with **no screenshot** — token-cheap. |
...
| **`system`** | Monitor layout + DPI/scale, cursor position, clipboard get/set, and viewport management. |
...
Coordinates are physical pixels in virtual-desktop space (primary monitor's top-left is `(0,0)`;
monitors to the left/above are negative). You click in the **image space** of the last
`screenshot`; the server maps that back to physical pixels (handling downscale, per-monitor
offset, and DPI). Every screenshot returns a `capture_id`; `act` errors loudly if you click
against a stale frame instead of mis-clicking. Use `system displays` to see the layout, then
target a specific monitor with `display:0` / `display:primary|left|right`.

23	本报告深度分析了8个开源Agent项目的核心实现，提取了300+关键代码模式和架构决策。
24	
25	### 核心发现
26	
27	**1. AionUi - 最成熟的Electron Agent平台**
28	- 完整的Team Mode实现（Leader + Teammates协作）
29	- 内置Agent引擎 + 外部Agent集成（Claude Code, Codex等）
30	- MCP统一管理 + 跨Agent配置同步
31	- 完善的IPC架构（主进程-渲染进程通信）
32	
33	**2. hermes-agent - 最强大的技能系统**
34	- 动态技能发现和加载（SKILL.md frontmatter解析）
35	- 三层技能体系（builtin / custom / extension）
36	- FTS5全文搜索 + LLM Embedding混合检索
37	- 技能版本管理和平台兼容性检测
38	
39	**3. cherry-studio - 最完善的MCP集成**
40	- MCP Server生命周期管理（启停、崩溃恢复、OAuth）
41	- 多传输协议支持（stdio / SSE / Streamable HTTP）
42	- 内存中MCP Server（filesystem、browser等）
43	- 详细的日志缓冲和错误追踪
44	
45	**4. UI-TARS-desktop - 最先进的Computer Use**
46	- nut-js封装（跨平台鼠标键盘控制）
47	- 无前台焦点夺取（后台操作）
48	- Action Parser（LLM输出 → 结构化动作）
49	- IPC桥接（主进程Operator ↔ 渲染进程UI）
50

52	- 子Agent创建和调度
53	- Docker沙盒隔离

```typescript
async function runGUIAgent(instruction: string) {
  while (true) {
    // 1. 截图
    const screenshot = await computerUse.screenshot();
    
    // 2. 发送给 Vision LLM
    const action = await visionLLM.analyze(screenshot, instruction);

  }
}
```

#### 3.4 Leader 调度逻辑
```typescript
class LeaderAgent {
  async executeTask(instruction: string) {
    // 1. 分解任务
    const subtasks = await this.decomposeTask(instruction);
    
    // 2. 分配给 Teammates
    const promises = subtasks.map(async (task) => {
      const teammate = this.findBestTeammate(task);
      return this.delegateTask(teammate, task);
    });
    
    // 3. 并行执行
    const results = await Promise.all(promises);
    
    // 4. 聚合结果
    return this.aggregateResults(results);
  }
}
```

```typescript
// packages/server/src/services/mcp/manager.ts
import { Client } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js';
import { spawn, ChildProcess } from 'child_process';

interface MCPServerConfig {
  id: string;
  command: string;
  args: string[];
  env?: Record<string, string>;
  transport: 'stdio' | 'sse';
}

class MCPServerManager {
  private servers = new Map<string, ChildProcess>();
  private clients = new Map<string, Client>();
  
  async start(config: MCPServerConfig): Promise<void> {
    // 1. spawn 子进程
    const proc = spawn(config.command, config.args, {
      env: { ...process.env, ...config.env },
    });
    
    // 2. 创建 MCP Client
    const client = new Client({
      name: 'oxygenclaw',
      version: '1.0.0',
    }, {
      capabilities: {},
    });
    
    // 3. 连接到 stdio
    await client.connect(new StdioClientTransport({
      command: config.command,
      args: config.args,
    }));
    
    this.servers.set(config.id, proc);
    this.clients.set(config.id, client);
    
    // 4. 监听崩溃并自动重启
    proc.on('exit', () => this.restart(config));
  }
  
  async callTool(serverId: string, toolName: string, args: any) {
    const client = this.clients.get(serverId);
    return client.callTool({ name: toolName, arguments: args });
  }
}
```

## 活跃项目

### OxygenClaw (`oxygen-claw`)
- 下一代多模型 AI Agent 平台,monorepo,版本 `26.0.0-alpha.1`。
- 定位:**终端 + 视觉双修的 Computer Use Claw**(开源)。computeruse 是核心卖点,不是可选项。

## 技术教训(踩过的坑)

### better-sqlite3 迁移
- **参数绑定比 sql.js 严格**:JS 布尔和 `undefined` 会直接抛错。解法:在 db.ts 的 `runQuery`/`runExec`/`runInsert` 单一入口做 `normalizeParams`(boolean→0/1、undefined→null、Date→毫秒),上层路由零改动。冒烟测试已确认这层必需。
- **`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS` 的静默陷阱**:若已存在同名的**非唯一**索引(旧 schema 建的),该语句会因名字已存在而被静默跳过,唯一约束不生效。解法:迁移时先检测 `PRAGMA index_list` 的 unique 标志→去重现有数据→`DROP` 旧索引→重建为 UNIQUE,做成幂等。**教训:tsc 通过 ≠ 运行时正确,DB 这类地基必须跑运行时冒烟测试验证。**

### 临时 Node 测试脚本
- 要 `require('better-sqlite3')` 的临时脚本**必须放在 `packages/server` 目录内**再跑,放 `/tmp` 会 MODULE_NOT_FOUND(node_modules 解析路径问题)。
- Bash 工具的**工作目录在命令间持久**。若之前 cd 进了子目录,再写 `cd packages/server && ...` 会因目录已在其中而失败、`&&` 链整体断掉。先确认 cwd。

### 前端类型安全(历史记录)
- **Message.content 支持多模态**:可以是 `string` 或 `ContentBlock[]`(text/image),后者用于支持视觉输入。MessageList 组件已适配两种格式。
- **Message.timestamp 后端改为 createdAt**:新 API 使用 `createdAt`,但兼容 `timestamp` 作为回退(旧数据可能仍用此字段)。
- **axios 拦截器类型**:request 拦截器需用 `InternalAxiosRequestConfig` 而非裸 `config`,否则 TS 报错。
- **NodeJS.Timeout 在浏览器环境不存在**:用 `ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>` 代替,跨环境兼容。

### RNW 迁移新挑战(2026-07-21)
- **RN 0.76+ 不再支持 react-native-windows-init**:需改用手动安装 react-native-windows 依赖,官方文档链接:`https://microsoft.github.io/react-native-windows/docs/getting-started`。
- **RNW 最高支持 RN 0.75.x**:0.76 支持尚未稳定,当前项目使用 RN 0.75.4 + RNW 0.75.x。
- **Windows 文件锁占用**:npm install 过程中可能出现 EPERM/ENOTEMPTY 错误,需完全删除 node_modules 和 package-lock.json 再重试,或在新目录重新创建项目。
- **Electron → RNW 架构映射**:Main Process → TurboModule,Renderer → JS Thread,IPC → 直接函数调用。
- **Node.js APIs 不可用**:需自定义 TurboModule 封装原生能力。
- **Computer Use 实现**:TurboModule(C++/C# 封装 Windows API)或 Node.js 子进程(调用 nut-js)。
- **磁盘空间管理**:C 盘曾仅剩 3.73 GB,现已释放到 6.46 GB,需定期清理或迁移数据。

131	- **参数绑定比 sql.js 严格**:JS 布尔和 `undefined` 会直接抛错。解法:在 db.ts 的 `runQuery`/`runExec`/`runInsert` 单一入口做 `normalizeParams`(boolean→0/1、undefined→null、Date→毫秒),上层路由零改动。冒烟测试已确认这层必需。
132	- **`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS` 的静默陷阱**:若已存在同名的**非唯一**索引(旧 schema 建的),该语句会因名字已存在而被静默跳过,唯一约束不生效。解法:迁移时先检测 `PRAGMA index_list` 的 unique 标志→去重现有数据→`DROP` 旧索引→重建为 UNIQUE,做成幂等。**教训:tsc 通过 ≠ 运行时正确,DB 这类地基必须跑运行时冒烟测试验证。**

The real issue is likely that we're running a mismatched or incomplete electron.exe binary downloaded via the mirror, or the test I ran with plain `node` was actually correct — it should return the path string in that context, not the API object.

Actually, wait — when we run `electron.exe out/main/index.js`, `require('electron')` should give us the API, but it's returning something without `.app` defined. A common culprit is the `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` environment variable being set to "1", which forces electron to run as pure Node and makes `require('electron')` return just the path string. I set that variable in a PowerShell test earlier, but since each shell invocation is a fresh session, that shouldn't persist to other commands.

Let me explicitly unset that variable and try launching electron by pointing it at the package directory (which has the `package.json` with the `main` field) instead of passing the JS file directly — that's often the cleaner way to invoke Electron.

核实重点:better-sqlite3 能否免本地编译地跑在 Electron 43 上(prebuilt 二进制 / @electron/rebuild 的 ABI 覆盖)。
看起来 better-sqlite3 v12.12.0 已经为 Electron 43 提供了官方的预编译二进制文件，这在 Windows 上已经过测试验证。Linux 虽然有 glibc 的兼容性问题，但这里讨论的是 Windows 环境，所以不是阻碍因素。

早期版本的编译错误只影响从源码构建的情况，而预编译二进制恰好规避了这个问题。

所以方案是用 better-sqlite3 v12.12.0+ 配合支持 Electron 43 ABI 的 node-abi（v3.75+），Windows 上可以直接获取预编译二进制，完全避免本地 VS 编译。这样 Phase 1 的数据库层既不需要安装 VS2022，也不需要切换到 sql.js。

不过有个实际风险需要坦诚说明：预编译二进制的下载依赖于安装时正确识别 Electron 43 的 ABI，如果环境探测失败可能还是会回退到源码编译。稳妥的做法是安装后用 `@electron/rebuild` 验证或确认 `.node` 文件能被 Electron 正常加载。

我应该把这个结论和建议反馈给泽川让他决策，这是 Phase 1 的关键改动，不应该自己直接动手。
调研有结论了，直接给你拍板依据。

## 核心结论:方向 3 成立,且是最优解

**better-sqlite3 已在 v12.12.0 正式支持 Electron 43 的 prebuilt 二进制**(官方 PR #1490,2026-06-30 合并,明确说明**已在 Windows 上测试通过**)。这意味着:

- Windows 平台可以**直接拉预编译的 `.node` 二进制,免本地 VS 编译**——绕开 VS2026 node-gyp 不识别的整个死结
- 不用装 VS2022(省 C 盘)、不用降级换 sql.js(前后端保持 better-sqlite3 一致)

## 三个方向的最终对比

| 方向 | 结论 |
|---|---|
| ① 装 VS2022 并存 | 可行但没必要了——白占 C 盘空间 |
| ② 换 sql.js/libsql | 可行但劣——性能差、前后端 DB 不一致 |
| **③ prebuilt 二进制** | ✅ **推荐**——零编译、前后端一致、成本最低 |

## 一个必须诚实说明的风险点

搜索还暴露了配套细节:早期版本(12.10.x)在 Electron 42+ 从源码编译会失败(V8 API 变更,`SetNativeDataProperty` 重载歧义)。所以关键是**锁死两点**:
1. `better-sqlite3` 用 **≥12.12.0**
2. `node-abi` 需 **≥3.75**(才认识 Electron 43 的 ABI 号),否则 electron-builder/@electron/rebuild 会误判版本、fallback 回源码编译

只要这两个版本对上,Windows 直接下 prebuilt。**但我还没在你机器上实测过 `npm install` 会不会真的走 prebuilt 而非 fallback 源码编译**——这是我唯一没验证的环节。

## 建议

方向 3。如果你同意,Phase 1 我第一步就先做一个最小验证:装 `better-sqlite3@^12.12.0`,跑一次 `require` 加载测试,确认 prebuilt 真的生效、没退回源码编译。**这一步跑通,整个 DB 层地基就稳了**;万一 prebuilt 在你环境失效,再退回方向 1/2 也不迟,损失只有几分钟。

## Phase 1 方案(请拍板)

核心框架四块,建议按此顺序做:

1. **IPC 架构规范化**——现在只有裸 `ping/pong`。建一套类型安全的 IPC 层:统一 channel 常量、`ipcMain.handle` 路由注册表、preload 经 contextBridge 暴露 typed API、renderer 侧封装调用。这是后续所有主/渲染进程通信的骨架。

4. **错误处理**——主进程 `uncaughtException`/`unhandledRejection` 兜底、IPC 调用统一 error 包装、渲染进程 ErrorBoundary。

     - Purpose: Core IPC routing logic - type-safe wrapper around ipcMain.handle
     - Exports IpcHandler type and createIpcRouter function
     - Pattern: accepts handler map, registers all with error wrapping, returns cleanup function
     - Key code:
     ```typescript
     export type IpcHandler = (event: IpcMainInvokeEvent, ...args: any[]) => Promise<any> | any

     export function createIpcRouter(handlers: Record<string, IpcHandler>): () => void {
       const channels = Object.keys(handlers)
       
       for (const channel of channels) {
         const handler = handlers[channel]
         ipcMain.handle(channel, async (event, ...args) => {
           try {
             return await handler(event, ...args)
           } catch (error) {
             console.error(`[IPC Error] Channel: ${channel}`, error)
             throw error
           }
         })
       }

       return () => {
         for (const channel of channels) {
           ipcMain.removeHandler(channel)
         }
       }
     }
     ```

   - **packages/electron-ui/src/main/ipc/index.ts** (created)
     - Purpose: Central IPC initialization - aggregates all domain handlers and registers router
     - Imports handlers from conversation, message, task, settings, mcp, database
     - Exports initializeIpc() and cleanupIpc()
     - Key pattern:
     ```typescript
     const allHandlers = {
       ...conversationHandlers,
       ...messageHandlers,
       ...taskHandlers,
       ...settingsHandlers,
       ...mcpHandlers,
       ...databaseHandlers
     }

     let cleanup: (() => void) | null = null

     export function initializeIpc(): void {
       cleanup = createIpcRouter(allHandlers)
     }

     export function cleanupIpc(): void {
       cleanup?.()
       cleanup = null
     }
     ```

130	### better-sqlite3 迁移
131	- **参数绑定比 sql.js 严格**:JS 布尔和 `undefined` 会直接抛错。解法:在 db.ts 的 `runQuery`/`runExec`/`runInsert` 单一入口做 `normalizeParams`(boolean→0/1、undefined→null、Date→毫秒),上层路由零改动。冒烟测试已确认这层必需。
132	- **`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS` 的静默陷阱**:若已存在同名的**非唯一**索引(旧 schema 建的),该语句会因名字已存在而被静默跳过,唯一约束不生效。解法:迁移时先检测 `PRAGMA index_list` 的 unique 标志→去重现有数据→`DROP` 旧索引→重建为 UNIQUE,做成幂等。**教训:tsc 通过 ≠ 运行时正确,DB 这类地基必须跑运行时冒烟测试验证。**

     ```typescript
     import Database from 'better-sqlite3'
     import { app } from 'electron'
     import { join } from 'path'
     import { existsSync, mkdirSync } from 'fs'

     let db: Database.Database | null = null

     export function getDatabase(): Database.Database {
       if (db) return db

       const userDataPath = app.getPath('userData')
       const dbDir = join(userDataPath, 'data')
       if (!existsSync(dbDir)) {
         mkdirSync(dbDir, { recursive: true })
       }

       const dbPath = join(dbDir, 'oxygenclaw.db')
       db = new Database(dbPath, {
         verbose: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? console.log : undefined
       })

       db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL')
       db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON')
       return db
     }

     export function closeDatabase(): void {
       if (db) {
         db.close()
         db = null
       }
     }

     export function normalizeParams(params: any[]): any[] {
       return params.map(p => {
         if (typeof p === 'boolean') return p ? 1 : 0
         if (p === undefined) return null
         if (p instanceof Date) return p.getTime()
         return p
       })
     }
     ```

     ```typescript
     import { getDatabase, normalizeParams } from '../../database'

     export const databaseHandlers: Record<string, IpcHandler> = {
       [DB_QUERY]: async (_, req: DbQueryRequest): Promise<unknown[]> => {
         const db = getDatabase()
         const stmt = db.prepare(req.sql)
         const params = req.params ? normalizeParams(req.params) : []
         return stmt.all(...params)
       },

       [DB_EXECUTE]: async (_, req: DbExecuteRequest): Promise<{ changes: number; lastInsertRowid: number }> => {
         const db = getDatabase()
         const stmt = db.prepare(req.sql)
         const params = req.params ? normalizeParams(req.params) : []
         const info = stmt.run(...params)
         return {
           changes: info.changes,
           lastInsertRowid: Number(info.lastInsertRowid)
         }
       },

       [DB_TRANSACTION]: async (_, req: DbTransactionRequest): Promise<void> => {
         const db = getDatabase()
         const transaction = db.transaction(() => {
           for (const stmt of req.statements) {
             const prepared = db.prepare(stmt.sql)
             const params = stmt.params ? normalizeParams(stmt.params) : []
             prepared.run(...params)
           }
         })
         transaction()
       }
     }
     ```

130	### better-sqlite3 迁移
131	- **参数绑定比 sql.js 严格**:JS 布尔和 `undefined` 会直接抛错。解法:在 db.ts 的 `runQuery`/`runExec`/`runInsert` 单一入口做 `normalizeParams`(boolean→0/1、undefined→null、Date→毫秒),上层路由零改动。冒烟测试已确认这层必需。
132	- **`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS` 的静默陷阱**:若已存在同名的**非唯一**索引(旧 schema 建的),该语句会因名字已存在而被静默跳过,唯一约束不生效。解法:迁移时先检测 `PRAGMA index_list` 的 unique 标志→去重现有数据→`DROP` 旧索引→重建为 UNIQUE,做成幂等。**教训:tsc 通过 ≠ 运行时正确,DB 这类地基必须跑运行时冒烟测试验证。**

### Part 2: SQLite + Drizzle 集成 (✅ 完成)

#### 2.1 数据库连接管理
- **文件**: `src/main/database/connection.ts`
- **功能**:
  - 单例模式: `getDatabase()` 返回全局唯一实例
  - WAL 模式: `PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL` (读写并发优化)
  - 外键约束: `PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON`
  - 参数归一化: `normalizeParams()` 处理 boolean→0/1, undefined→null, Date→timestamp
  - 生命周期: 启动时初始化，退出时 `closeDatabase()`
  - 数据目录: `{userData}/data/oxygenclaw.db`

#### 2.2 数据库 Schema
- **文件**: `src/main/database/schema.ts`
- **工具**: Drizzle ORM (仅用于类型定义，实际查询用 better-sqlite3 原生 SQL)
- **表结构**:
  1. **conversations**: id, title, model, created_at, updated_at
  2. **messages**: id, conversation_id (FK → conversations, ON DELETE CASCADE), role, content, created_at
     - 索引: `idx_messages_conversation`, `idx_messages_created`
  3. **tasks**: id, conversation_id (FK → conversations, ON DELETE SET NULL), type, status, result, error, created_at, updated_at
     - 索引: `idx_tasks_status`, `idx_tasks_conversation`
  4. **settings**: key (PK), value (JSON), updated_at
  5. **mcp_servers**: id, name, command, args (JSON), env (JSON), status, created_at, updated_at

#### 2.3 数据库迁移
- **文件**: `src/main/database/migrations.ts`
- **功能**:
  - `initializeSchema()`: 幂等 DDL，使用 `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`
  - 索引创建: `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS`
  - 外键约束: 显式声明 FOREIGN KEY 与级联规则
  - 启动调用: `src/main/index.ts` 在 `app.whenReady()` 后立即执行

#### 2.4 数据层实现细节

**Conversation Handler**:
- `list()`: 按 `updated_at DESC` 排序
- `get(id)`: 单条查询，不存在返回 `null`
- `create(req)`: 生成 ID (`conv_${timestamp}_${random}`)，插入 DB
- `delete(req)`: 级联删除关联 messages (FK constraint)

**Message Handler**:
- `list(req)`: 按 `created_at ASC` 排序，过滤 `conversation_id`
- `send(req)`: 插入用户消息 + 更新 conversation.updated_at (TODO: Phase 2+ 调用 LLM 生成 assistant 回复)

**Settings Handler**:
- `get()`: 读取 `app_settings` key，首次启动插入默认值
- `update(req)`: 增量合并更新 (`{ ...current, ...req }`)，写回 DB
- 默认值:
  ```typescript
  {
    theme: 'system',
    language: 'zh-CN',
    defaultModel: 'claude-opus-4',
    apiKeys: {}
  }
  ```

**Database Handler**:
- `query(req)`: `stmt.all()` 返回结果集
- `execute(req)`: `stmt.run()` 返回 `{ changes, lastInsertRowid }`
- `transaction(req)`: 原子执行多条语句

## 三、技术亮点与架构决策

### 3.1 参数归一化
- **问题**: better-sqlite3 对参数类型严格，JS 的 `boolean` 和 `undefined` 会抛错
- **解决方案**: 在 `connection.ts` 的 `normalizeParams()` 单一入口处理
  - `boolean` → `0/1`
  - `undefined` → `null`
  - `Date` → `timestamp (milliseconds)`
- **优势**: 上层 handler 零改动，统一规范

### 3.2 外键级联
- **conversations → messages**: `ON DELETE CASCADE` (删除对话自动清理消息)
- **conversations → tasks**: `ON DELETE SET NULL` (删除对话后任务解绑)
- **验证**: UI 测试第 6 项确认级联删除生效

### 3.3 WAL 模式
- **配置**: `PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL`
- **优势**: 读写并发性能优化，适合 Electron 多进程场景

### 3.4 类型安全
- **端到端**: DB → Handler → IPC → Preload → Renderer 全程 TypeScript 守护
- **字段映射**: DB `snake_case` ↔ TS `camelCase` 在 handler 层统一转换

### 3.5 ID 生成策略
- **格式**: `${prefix}_${timestamp}_${random}`
- **示例**: `conv_1738012345678_a7b3k2m`
- **优势**: 时间戳排序 + 碰撞避免

## 九、常见问题与解决方案

### Q1: npm install 失败，better-sqlite3 下载超时
**A**: 使用国内镜像
```bash
npm install --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com
```

### Q2: Electron 窗口启动报错 "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'whenReady')"
**A**: 检查环境变量污染
```bash
# Bash/Zsh
unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE

# PowerShell
Remove-Item Env:\ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE
```

### Q3: TypeScript 报错 "Cannot find module 'better-sqlite3'"
**A**: 确认 better-sqlite3 已在 `electron.vite.config.ts` 的 `external` 中声明
```typescript
export default defineConfig({
  main: {
    build: {
      rollupOptions: {
        external: ['better-sqlite3']
      }
    }
  }
})
```

### Q4: 数据库文件在哪里？
**A**: 
```javascript
// Main 进程
const { app } = require('electron')
const dbPath = path.join(app.getPath('userData'), 'data', 'oxygenclaw.db')
console.log(dbPath)
```

40	## 3. 已完成工作（Lot 1–3）
41	
42	### Lot 1 · P0-1 · DB 迁移（✅ 已完成）
43	- **病灶**：旧 `services/db.ts` 用 sql.js，每次写都全库 `export()` + 全量覆盖落盘；`PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL` 对纯内存 WASM 完全无效（虚假安全感）。数据丢失 + 性能灾难。
44	- **修复**：换成 better-sqlite3。新增 `runTransaction<T>(fn: () => T): T`（包装 `db.transaction(fn)()`）。
45	- **兼容层**：better-sqlite3 参数绑定比 sql.js 严格，JS 布尔和 `undefined` 会直接抛错。解法：在 `runQuery`/`runExec`/`runInsert` 单一入口做 `normalizeParams`（boolean→0/1、undefined→null、Date→毫秒），上层路由零改动。**此层经冒烟测试确认必需。**
46	- **备份**：迁移前已备份 `data/oxygenclaw.db.bak-<时间戳>`。
47	
48	### Lot 2 · P0-2 · event seq 竞态根治（✅ 已完成）

71	## 4. 关键运行时架构（供理解 Lot 4）
72	
73	- **RuntimeWorkerManager**（`services/runtimeWorkerManager.ts`）：queue + 并发上限 + 心跳 + `sweepStaleTasks` + `failInterruptedTasks`。
74	  - `cancel(taskId)` 同时处理排队中和运行中的 job，运行中会调 `adapter.cancel?.(taskId)`。
75	  - `sweepStaleTasks()` 把心跳超时的 running 任务标 failed，并 `recordRuntimeEvent({type:'task_error'})` —— 这**会**发到事件总线。
76	- **事件总线**：`runtimeEventBus`（EventEmitter），按 `task:${taskId}` 频道；终态事件类型：`task_complete` / `task_error` / `task_cancelled`。
77	- **SSE**（`routes/agent.ts`）：`streamRuntimeTask` 与 `/tasks/:id/events/live` 先回放历史事件，再 `subscribeRuntimeEvents` 订阅；收到终态事件写 `[DONE]` + `res.end()`。
78	- **Settings 加密**：敏感字段（visionApiKey / asrApiKey / ttsApiKey / imageGenApiKey / dashboardApiKey）AES-256-GCM，前缀 `encrypted:aes256-gcm:`。

130	### better-sqlite3 迁移
131	- **参数绑定比 sql.js 严格**:JS 布尔和 `undefined` 会直接抛错。解法:在 db.ts 的 `runQuery`/`runExec`/`runInsert` 单一入口做 `normalizeParams`(boolean→0/1、undefined→null、Date→毫秒),上层路由零改动。冒烟测试已确认这层必需。
132	- **`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS` 的静默陷阱**:若已存在同名的**非唯一**索引(旧 schema 建的),该语句会因名字已存在而被静默跳过,唯一约束不生效。解法:迁移时先检测 `PRAGMA index_list` 的 unique 标志→去重现有数据→`DROP` 旧索引→重建为 UNIQUE,做成幂等。**教训:tsc 通过 ≠ 运行时正确,DB 这类地基必须跑运行时冒烟测试验证。**
133	
134	### 临时 Node 测试脚本
135	- 要 `require('better-sqlite3')` 的临时脚本**必须放在 `packages/server` 目录内**再跑,放 `/tmp` 会 MODULE_NOT_FOUND(node_modules 解析路径问题)。
136	- Bash 工具的**工作目录在命令间持久**。若之前 cd 进了子目录,再写 `cd packages/server && ...` 会因目录已在其中而失败、`&&` 链整体断掉。先确认 cwd。

140	- **Message.timestamp 后端改为 createdAt**:新 API 使用 `createdAt`,但兼容 `timestamp` 作为回退(旧数据可能仍用此字段)。
141	- **axios 拦截器类型**:request 拦截器需用 `InternalAxiosRequestConfig` 而非裸 `config`,否则 TS 报错。

/**
 * React 错误边界组件
 * 捕获子组件树中的 JavaScript 错误，记录日志并显示降级 UI
 */
export class ErrorBoundary extends Component<Props, State> {
  constructor(props: Props) {
    super(props)
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null }
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): State {
    return { hasError: true, error }
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: ErrorInfo): void {
    logger.error('React error boundary caught error', {
      error: error.message,
      stack: error.stack,
      componentStack: errorInfo.componentStack
    })
  }

  render(): ReactNode {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      if (this.props.fallback) {
        return this.props.fallback
      }

      return (
        <div style={{
          padding: '2rem',
          textAlign: 'center',
          backgroundColor: '#fef2f2',
          border: '1px solid #fecaca',
          borderRadius: '8px',
          margin: '1rem'

          <h2 style={{ color: '#dc2626', marginBottom: '0.5rem' }}>出错了</h2>
          <p style={{ color: '#7f1d1d', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
            {this.state.error?.message || '未知错误'}
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={() => this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null })}
            style={{
              padding: '0.5rem 1rem',
              backgroundColor: '#dc2626',
              color: 'white',
              border: 'none',
              borderRadius: '6px',
              cursor: 'pointer'
            }}
          >
            重试
          </button>
        </div>
      )
    }

    return this.props.children
  }

interface ToastMessage {
  id: string
  type: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info'
  message: string
}

let toastId = 0
const toastListeners = new Set<(toast: ToastMessage) => void>()

/**
 * Toast 通知工具
 */
export const toast = {
  success: (message: string) => {
    const id = `toast-${toastId++}`
    toastListeners.forEach(listener => listener({ id, type: 'success', message }))
  },
  error: (message: string) => {
    const id = `toast-${toastId++}`
    toastListeners.forEach(listener => listener({ id, type: 'error', message }))
  },
  warning: (message: string) => {
    const id = `toast-${toastId++}`
    toastListeners.forEach(listener => listener({ id, type: 'warning', message }))
  },
  info: (message: string) => {
    const id = `toast-${toastId++}`
    toastListeners.forEach(listener => listener({ id, type: 'info', message }))
  }
}

/**
 * Toast 容器组件
 */
export function ToastContainer(): JSX.Element {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastMessage[]>([])

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleToast = (toast: ToastMessage) => {
      setToasts(prev => [...prev, toast])
      setTimeout(() => {
        setToasts(prev => prev.filter(t => t.id !== toast.id))
      }, 3000)
    }

    toastListeners.add(handleToast)
    return () => {
      toastListeners.delete(handleToast)
    }
  }, [])

  const getBackgroundColor = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'success': return '#10b981'
      case 'error': return '#ef4444'
      case 'warning': return '#f59e0b'
      case 'info': return '#3b82f6'
      default: return '#6b7280'
    }
  }

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed',
      top: '1rem',
      right: '1rem',
      zIndex: 9999,
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      gap: '0.5rem'
    }}>
      {toasts.map(toast => (
        <div
          key={toast.id}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: getBackgroundColor(toast.type),
            color: 'white',
            padding: '0.75rem 1rem',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            boxShadow: '0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)',
            minWidth: '250px',
            maxWidth: '400px',
            animation: 'slideIn 0.3s ease-out'
          }}
        >
          {toast.message}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}
